io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous active-high reset; clears history to zero.

io.name: predict_valid
io.description: Indicates a branch prediction is being made; shift predict_taken into history.

io.name: predict_taken
io.description: Predicted direction of the youngest branch.

io.name: train_mispredicted
io.description: Indicates a branch misprediction; load history from train_history concatenated with train_taken.

io.name: train_taken
io.description: Actual direction of the mispredicted branch.

io.name: predict_history
io.description: Current branch history register value; bit 0 is youngest branch.

functional_summary.overview: 32-bit global branch history shift register with prediction shifting and misprediction rollback. Asynchronously reset to zero by areset. On each posedge, if train_mispredicted is asserted, load {train_history, train_taken} (train_taken as LSB); otherwise if predict_valid is asserted, shift left by one and insert predict_taken at LSB. Misprediction takes precedence over prediction.
rules: areset asserted (async, active high) forces predict_history to 0 regardless of clock.

On posedge with areset deasserted: if train_mispredicted=1, predict_history <= {train_history[31:1], train_history[0]} with train_taken inserted at LSB, i.e. predict_history <= (train_history << 1) | train_taken.
When both predict_valid and train_mispredicted are asserted, misprediction path takes precedence.
predict_history[0] represents the direction of the youngest branch.
